core_findings.result: The largest-term argument gives norm<=1 for every coefficient and every integral root. Conversely the norm unit ball in the actual finite field Q_ell(z) is finite over Z_ell by the already proved WRP2 argument, so its determinant polynomial proves integrality. Transport uses exactly the specified algebraic iota, with no continuity assumed. IsIntUnit is nonzero plus integrality of the value and inverse; this is exactly norm1.

The reversed monic polynomial for x(a)^(-1) contradicts the unit1+m_A when a is in m_A and |x(a)|>=1. Residue surjectivity then bounds x(A). Finite ideal generators give one geometric decay constant for all powers and all elements, even for nonreduced A. Recursive polynomial approximation using the same generators and O0-residue representatives puts every x(a) in one actual finite coefficient field, using the closed-subspace argument GA2. Its integer ring contains O0 and x(A). WRP12 enlarges this actual ring and supplies the unchanged algRep with all WtRep fields. The resulting codrestriction alpha is local because m_A maps to norm<1, and the scalar tower is exactly beta alpha=iota x. All original CNL and finite residue hypotheses are checked.

Compact-torus integrality and the zeroth row lift chi uniquely into O units; inversion and multiplicativity descend by beta injective. Dividing specialized theta by this character gives the literal finite-part values on every elementary torus coordinate. The depth c*=max(e0,W.c0) and exact Tc(c*)=coordinate units congruent1 modulo m^(c*+1) give both required trivialities. Elementary diagonal factorization proves the complete torus eigenlaw. UQ is contained in the original lev(K), so Big adds no unmatched condition, yielding literal ClAt=Cl. The tau identity uses x as an O0-algebra map on every matrix entry.

The exact WRP low-weight formula gives chi(alV(v,j))=lowVal(v,j). The alV exponents are nonincreasing, so these are all actual positive elements, including j>=n. Original local opC uses j+1 for j in Fin n. In contrast z is the product over0<=j<n: counting j>i gives exponent n-1-i. Applying chi gives exactly the source uzC normalization. The same ambient operator, literal ClAt equality, and norm1 iff integral-unit test identify each spectral summand of OrdAt and ClOrd, at every K and e.

Componentwise compact-open intersections give the exact directed family under joins. For an auxiliary translate by g, replacing K_q with gK_qg^(-1) has the correct multiplication order and stays compact open. Q_UQ and Q_Q give every other invariance; the stabilizer subgroup contains the original join. The level is chosen before the coefficient ring and representation, exactly matching the source lev_act quantifiers.

The original spherical orbit is finite by compactness of GL_n(O_w) and discreteness of its right-coset quotient. The original quotient.out representatives in dc are independent of the coefficient ring and representation, so one actual finite list realizes the operator on the full ambient representation; no averaging is introduced. On fixed vectors coset permutation gives C_w invariance. W_dec, W_le and sectionsCommuteAtSplit then give invariance under the exact original level join, with no unjustified normality assumption.

Every SMP hypothesis is matched on the given point and H objects: actual local coefficient map, all WtRep fields, continuous theta and free stabilizers, one phi and depth, directed original levels, finite-level condition, and prescribed complex tau. Its unique-good-lift map is fixed before all levels and operators. Classical finiteness, every local and spherical stability assertion, and every nonzero classical eigenvalue norm bound follow from SMP2-SMP3 and the exact normalizations.

Additivity, scalar iota(x(b)), all-level ordinary span, and independence of every A-basis use the same map. The source local operators use SMP8; source spherical operators use the same finite list on A and C and the entire fixed-space inclusion required by SMP9.
